## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND provide two independent confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Credit and stocks-vs-bonds neutral: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) → flat, ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) → flat, ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Duration preference intact: TLT (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) → flat, ABOVE TREND while Stocks vs Bonds (level 8.6080) → flat, BELOW TREND, so financial conditions broadly neutral-to-supportive. Dollar indicators neutral and yield curve flat → flat, NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Growth/tech leadership: XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US broad indices above trend: SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +5.57%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; EM strength notable: EEM (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rising: Speculation Index ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND with ARKK (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. Crypto weakness persists: IBIT (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Copper showing short-term correction: CPER (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) → flat, CORRECTION; Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) → flat, RECOVERY while silver SLV (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Oil sharply weak: USO (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; broader energy ETF XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND while natural gas UNG (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND show aligned strength. DIVERGENCE: several sector ETFs flagged CORRECTION/RECOVERY (e.g., XLV 1W: -3.04% | 1M: +1.41% CORRECTION; CPER 1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27% CORRECTION) — minor, not systemic.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to growth/tech and semis (XLK, QQQ, SOXX) given above-trend momentum; reduce exposure to energy/commodity crude ETFs (XLE, USO, BNO) showing weakness. Monitor bond-duration via TLT (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) → flat, ABOVE TREND as a tactical hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Semis & Tech — SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy & Commodities — XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND and USO (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY and selective copper strength CPER (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) → flat, CORRECTION. BEARISH: Crude and broad energy complex — BNO (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) as complacency threshold; Stocks vs Bonds 8.61 (SPY/TLT level 8.6080) → flat, BELOW TREND to watch for risk tilt. Tech vs Financials 3.57 (Tech vs Financials level 3.5736) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND as leadership pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND confirm. Tech and semis showing relative strength: XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: divergence in defensives/healthcare and commodity-linked energy — XLV (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +1.41%) CORRECTION and XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND to monitor.
